title: Hearing on Sanitation and Public Budgets for Fiscal 2027
summary: The Council holds budget and oversight hearings on the Preliminary Budget for Fiscal Year 2027, the Preliminary Capital Plan for Fiscal Years 2027-2030 and the Fiscal 2026 Preliminary Mayor's Management Report. The morning session at 10:30 a.m. examines the Department of Sanitation, followed by a related public session at 12:00 p.m.
